summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443 with automatic certificate renewal and uninterrupted live certificate pickup. Configuration and certificate state survived the required node restart.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled a systemd-managed HTTPS service listening on 0.0.0.0:8443.
Configured a persistent daily renewal timer that renews certificates with fewer than seven days remaining.
Opened TCP/8443 in runtime and permanent firewalld configuration.
Verified renewal from a one-day certificate to a new 30-day certificate while all 60 test requests returned HTTP 200 and the service PID remained unchanged.
Restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and all required state recovered.

evidence.summary: Shows the active/enabled service, 8443 listener, firewall rules, successful HTTPS response, and live certificate before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Renew the certificate automatically before expiry
evidence.summary: Shows the enabled daily persistent timer and a successful timer-target renewal from a certificate expiring in one day to one valid for 30 days.

evidence.requirement: Pick up renewed certificates while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: Both rotation tests show changed live certificate fingerprints, unchanged service PIDs, and 140/140 total HTTPS requests returning HTTP 200 during renewal.

Captures the healthy pre-restart boot identity and reboot acknowledgement, the changed boot identity, and recovered HTTPS service, certificate, timer, firewall state, listener, and response with zero failed units.
